findings.issue: total_qty starts the loop at index 1, so items[0].qty is never added. The docstring says it sums the qty of every item, so any call with two or more items returns a total that is too low by the first item's qty. This affects every caller on common input.
findings.suggested_fix: for i in range(len(items)): total += items[i].qty, or more simply total = sum(i.qty for i in items)
